stages.oracle: The iOS app's first screen (Splash into Auth) tells a first-time visitor what Jovie does for them and offers one working next step; no error, quota or placeholder surface.

The canary signs in through the app's browser auth (MobileAuthCoordinator opens jov.ie/auth/start with client=ios and PKCE S256) and lands signed in as itself in the app; no waitlist wall, invite error or blank restoring screen.
Onboarding (Features/NeedsOnboarding) completes with the canary's own inputs reflected back, and the handle/context chosen in onboarding is the one the app keeps.
The canary sees the app's core value with its own data: the dashboard shows their releases and chat replies answer the question asked (no error body or quota wall).

The canary's account upgrades to Artist Presence at the live price through Jovie's web billing (Stripe test-mode checkout; the app shares web billing and has no separate in-app purchase), and the paid capabilities are live for that account in the iOS app.

accounts.source: prodcert canary identities (apps/web/lib/synthetic/prodcert-identities.ts), the same identities used to sign in on iOS; OTP read for that address only

paidOutcome.freeAlternative: Jovie Free on the same account (profile, smart links, release pages, fan capture) or a free link-in-bio

channels.route: apps/web/app/api/webhooks/resend-inbound (support@jov.ie per SUPPORT_EMAIL in apps/web/constants/domains.ts) -> lib/customer-voice -> Summer
